bioacoustic_dense.rule: Preserve source contour, density and microtiming.

machine_recurrent.rule: Translate attacks and recurrence into mouth/throat/chest behaviour.

human_language_present.rule: Language use requires provenance and consent where applicable.

hard_rules: No language is assigned from geographic location alone.
Nonlexical vocality must not be presented as an invented ancestral language.
Voice can remain absent even when vocal transformation is technically possible.
